restaurante-en.scenario: It's your 10th wedding anniversary this Saturday. You want a table for two around 7:30. Once the table is sorted, ask if they could decorate the table or do something special for the anniversary, like flowers or a candle on dessert. Later ask if there's parking.

barberia-en.scenario: You have a 4 o'clock appointment today with Andrés for a cut and beard, but you're stuck in traffic on I-10 and you'll be about 20 minutes late. Start by telling her you're running late and asking if you can still make it. Whatever she says, you decide to move it to tomorrow at the same time instead. Then, since it's been a rough week, ask what a hot towel shave costs and add it to tomorrow's appointment.

contador-en.scenario: You opened a food truck this year and you've never filed taxes for a business. Start by saying that. You're not sure if you should have been paying something during the year; ask her about it. Then ask if they can also help with bookkeeping every month so you don't fall behind. Finally, mention your wife needs to renew her ITIN and you're nervous about mailing her passport; ask if there's another way.

abogado-en.scenario: Your ex just had you served with papers to change your custody schedule, and the first hearing is next Tuesday. You're stressed and don't have a lawyer yet. Start by saying you got served with custody papers. When she asks, mention the hearing is next Tuesday. Ask how much a consultation costs and whether that money counts toward hiring them.

hvac-en.scenario: Nothing is broken. Your AC unit is about 15 years old, your electric bill keeps going up, and you're thinking about replacing it before next summer. Start by saying you're thinking about replacing your AC. Ask if they do estimates for a new system and if that costs anything. Then ask if they also do a regular tune-up, because you have a rental house with an older unit too. Your address is 2215 Maple Ridge Lane, Katy, 77494.

dental-en.scenario: You're getting married in about six weeks and you'd like your teeth whiter for the photos. You haven't been to a dentist in a couple of years. Start by saying you're interested in teeth whitening. Ask if you should get a cleaning first. You have Delta Dental PPO insurance; ask if they take it. Book whatever she recommends.

taller-en.scenario: Your registration expires at the end of the month and you need your state inspection. You're also overdue for an oil change. Start with the inspection. Then add the oil change and ask the price for synthetic. You drive a 2017 Honda Accord. Ask if you can wait there while they do it, and if you come before 10, whether it'll be done the same day.

bienes-raices-en.scenario: You're not buying: you want to rent. Your lease ends in about six weeks. You and your girlfriend want a three-bedroom house in Cypress, ideally under 2,400 a month, and you have a medium-size dog. Start by saying you're looking to rent a house. Share the details as she asks. Ask if a leasing agent can send you a few options.
